21 Hours Per Week

A Liverpool-based organisation is looking to appoint an experienced Sales Ledger / Credit Controller to support its finance team on a part-time temporary basis.

This opportunity would suit an experienced finance professional who can quickly settle into a new environment and take ownership of day-to-day sales ledger responsibilities with minimal training. The role will involve working within a busy finance function, ensuring invoices are raised accurately, payments are allocated correctly and customer accounts remain up to date.

Whilst there is a credit control aspect to the position, it is not a traditional debt-chasing role. A significant part of the role will involve investigating outstanding balances, resolving invoice queries and identifying reasons why payments may not have been received.

Key Responsibilities
- Raising and processing customer invoices
- Allocating incoming payments
- Maintaining accurate sales ledger records
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Investigating outstanding balances and payment queries
- Liaising with customers and stakeholders regarding invoices and payments
- Supporting credit control activities where required
- Resolving account discrepancies
- Assisting with general transactional finance duties
- Supporting the wider finance team as required

Person Specification
- Previous experience within a Sales Ledger and/or Credit Control role
- Able to hit the ground running with minimal supervision
- Strong experience of invoicing, payment allocation and reconciliations
- Confident managing customer accounts and resolving queries
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Strong communication skills
- Comfortable working within a busy office environment
- Experience using Xero would be advantageous but is not essential
- Available to start at short notice

Additional Information
- 21 hours per week
- Flexible working hours
- Fully office-based in Liverpool
- Temporary assignment with duration dependent on business requirements
- Immediate start available
- Hourly rate of £14.00 - £19.00 per hour, depending on experience

This role requires a candidate who can hit the ground running from day one. As such, applications will only be considered from individuals with previous Sales Ledger, Credit Control or wider Finance experience. Please do not apply if you do not have relevant finance experience.
